historyBefore.text: can I use personal account to run ads I cannot convert it

You cannot run ads using a personal Facebook or Instagram account directly because those accounts are not designed for advertising purposes. Instead, you need to convert or create a Business Manager account on Meta (which covers Facebook and Instagram). This business account allows for proper ad setup, payment methods, targeting, and tracking.

If you want, I can guide you on how to set up a business advertising account, or help you run ads through Joshspot's management service. Would you like assistance with setup only, or full ads management? Or do you want to try running ads yourself after setup?

To run ads on TikTok, you cannot use a personal account directly for advertising. You need to set up a TikTok Business Account, which gives you access to TikTok Ads Manager for creating and managing your campaigns properly.

Would you like help with just setting up your TikTok ad account so you can run ads yourself? Or do you want Joshspot to manage the TikTok ads for you as well? Let me know which option you prefer.
I already have followers but no ad account

You already have TikTok followers but no ad account, so the next step is to set up a TikTok Business Account to create and run ads.

Would you prefer that I guide you through just the account setup, so you can run your ads yourself? Or would you like Joshspot to manage the TikTok ads for you, including campaign creation and management? Let me know which option you want.

Which one do you prefer? If you want management, I can provide details on pricing and process next.
